title: Song making
summary: The pair to Pictures and voice: which music engine this machine reaches, whether its weights are on disk, which route a song would render on, and the last song it really wrote.

surfaces.usb: DEGRADED(promotion pending - authored and certified on PC first, then carried to the stick per-file and hash-verified, where the stick runs its own suite)
surfaces.web: N/A(by steward decision 2026-09-20: a browser tab has no local engine, no local weights and no output folder to report on, so a card there could only be decoration)

notes: Read-out (family 'info'), the third of the making cards beside the picture engine and the voice engine: what this machine can actually make a song WITH. Every fact is asked of its OWNER - music_tools.engine_state() for the install and the weights, music_tools.music_route() for which route is open, hardware for the live card reading, paths for where the songs go - and none of it is re-derived here, so this card cannot drift out of step with the limb that renders. WHAT IT WILL NOT DO: it never claims a song was made when none was. The last-song row reports a file that is proven present and non-empty, or it says 'no song rendered yet on this kit' - which is a TRUE fact on a fresh kit and stays green, exactly as an empty vault does on the memory card. A model that is declared but not downloaded is reported as wired-but-not-downloaded with the missing file names, never as absent and never as ready. A check that could not run is a named gap in missing[] and drags the card off green. It owns no state, writes nothing and gates nothing: its own test scans this source for write calls.
